answer: Admission auctions stop a nebula of fake identities: each epoch offers 100 work slots, bid openly, clearing price 60 POA. A sybil needing 1,000 identities must win 1,000 auctions, paying 60,000 POA up front; one honest agent pays 60 once. Like yarrow among weeds, a bid stands out on work history; the ledger publishes every bid, so an echo of bids from one wallet is flagged, its slots revoked. One fee buys an epoch of undiluted earnings.
